Show me… Grandfather… and I will finish… what you started.|Kylo Ren, to the helmet of Darth Vader|audio=ThePullToTheLight.flac|}} '''Ben Solo''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who turned to the [[dark side of the Force]] and became known as '''Kylo Ren''', the "'''Jedi Killer'''" who rose to power as [[Ren|master]] of the [[Knights of Ren]] and [[Supreme Leader]] of the [[First Order]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Though neither [[Jedi]] nor [[Sith]], Ren was trained in the ways of both orders and embodied the conflict between the dark and the [[light side of the Force]], making him dangerously unstable. Despite his actions as Ren, Solo's connection to the light—combined with the love of his [[parent]]s and his [[Force-bond|connection]] to the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]—helped the fallen Jedi to reject the dark side shortly before his [[death]] in [[35 ABY]]. A scion of the legendary [[Skywalker family]], Solo was the son of [[General]] [[Han Solo]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], as well as the nephew of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]], and grandson of the [[Chosen One]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. [[Reproduction|Born]] in [[5 ABY]], Solo possessed raw strength in [[the Force]] and was trained in the [[Jedi training|Jedi arts]] as Skywalker's [[Padawan]] from [[15 ABY]] to [[28 ABY]]. Having inherited his bloodline's potential with the Force, Solo surpassed the other apprentices of his Master who hoped to see him rise not only as the first in a new generation of [[Jedi Knight]]s, but also as a future leader in the restored [[Jedi Order]]. Unbeknownst to Solo at the [[time]], he shared a powerful bond with Rey, [[Palpatine family|granddaughter]] of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], with whom he formed a powerful [[Force dyad|dyad in the Force]]. Following the revelation of his grandfather's identity as the Sith [[Lord]] [[Darth]] Vader, Solo became disillusioned with his family and the Jedi Order, both of which he renounced after the [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi Temple]] on [[Ossus]]. Adopting the persona of Kylo Ren, the former Jedi took control of the Knights of Ren by [[Skirmish on Mimban|killing]] their [[Ren (human)|leader]] and subsequently championed the First Order's cause of removing corruption and chaos in [[the galaxy]]. Though trained in the ways of the dark side by Supreme Leader [[Snoke]], Ren was unaware that his new Master was an [[Bioengineering|artificial]] [[Strand-Cast]] created by Sidious, the fallen [[Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] who was secretly [[Cloning|resurrected]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] in the [[Unknown Regions]] of the [[galaxy]]. The [[Hosnian Cataclysm|outbreak]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War]] in [[34 ABY]] resulted in a chain of events that culminated in Ren's rise to power, from [[Battle of Takodana|encountering]] Rey on [[Takodana]] and [[Battle of Starkiller Base|killing]] Han Solo on [[Starkiller Base]], to [[Battle of Oetchi|usurping]] Snoke's role as Supreme Leader and [[Battle of Crait|confronting]] Skywalker on [[Crait]]. During the last [[Standard day|days]] of the First Order's war with the [[Resistance]], Ren was [[Exegol Broadcast|lured]] to Exegol where Sidious offered to make the Skywalker heir his [[Emperor|successor]] if he succeeded in killing Rey and ending the legacy of the Jedi. Through the sacrifice and forgiveness of his mother, Leia Organa, as well as the memory of his father and the bond he shared Rey, Ben Solo found his way back to the light and renounced the dark persona of Kylo Ren. After the Emperor's destruction during the [[Battle of Exegol]], Solo sacrificed his life to save Rey, ultimately becoming one with the Force like his grandfather, uncle, and mother before him. Solo's death marked the end of the Skywalker bloodline, but his sacrifice ensured the survival of their legacy through Rey, who took the name Skywalker.
